$comment: Teams own area paths; security groups gate approvals and required reviewers. Applied by tooling/Initialize-AzureDevOps.ps1.

teams.name: Platform Engineering
teams.description: Owns governance, pipeline templates, shared infrastructure, libraries and container base images.

teams.name: Identity Team
teams.description: Owns identity-service and the Entra ID role mapping.

teams.name: Experience Team
teams.description: Owns the SPA and the backend-for-frontend.

teams.name: SRE
teams.description: Owns observability, SLOs and production readiness.

securityGroups.name: Release Managers
securityGroups.description: Approve production deployments. Two approvals required, requester cannot approve.

securityGroups.name: QA Leads
securityGroups.description: Approve promotion into the test environment.

securityGroups.name: Security Champions
securityGroups.description: Required reviewers for auth, secrets, Dockerfiles and infrastructure changes.

securityGroups.name: Sync Automation
securityGroups.description: Holds the identity used by the GitHub sync workflow. Only member allowed to bypass branch policies on mirrored repos.
